subject: Quick thought on Suerte's website and layout
body: Hi Suerte team, I've always admired how you blend traditional nixtamalization with local Texas ingredients in East Austin. While dining with you is always top-tier, I noticed on your current site that the reservation journey bounces through third-party flows and your large party pages are slightly fragmented across multiple URLs. I spent a little time putting together a modern, live prototype for Suerte that streamlines your private dining information and adds direct navigation anchors for instant guest answers. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b5b6fb440001-0x48219815b358937-79ot2z5bq.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Consolidated large party and private dining information to eliminate redundant pages
Streamlined reservation flows and added direct anchor links for faster user navigation
